detail: Full summary: finding: on the FILES backend agents/registry.json is rewritten on virtually every write tool call — BlackboardEngine.touchAgent (blackboard.ts:80) fires from post (:143), resolve (:300) and decide (decisions.ts:405), writeJSON never short-circuits on unchanged bytes (file-store.ts:112-130) — and the file is tracked-not-ignored on both backends (init.ts:116-119 stub). Liveness thresholds are 5/30 min local signals (liveness.ts:7-10), but twining_register capabilities live in the same file, and plan R-10 rejected aggregates in GITIGNORE_ENTRIES. Recommendation to users sharing a files-backend store: ignore agents/registry.json; on sqlite-era stores it is a frozen aggregate (validate-records.ts:58).
